title: Vox C compile time: one unit vs -parallel-cc (ThinLTO), production prealloc flags
method: Scripts below (time_modes.sh, summarize_times.py): same staged V (parallel-cc-native-headers 57cb0da449) and production arguments; parallel = V generates, compiles 33 units concurrently and links with ThinLTO; single = V writes Vox.c then one clang -O3 -mllvm -inline-threshold=1500 call compiles and links it. Excludes the build steps both modes share (Rust, Skia/Graphite libraries, ad-block helper, signing). Order p1, s1, s2, p2 (ABBA) on an 18-core host shared with other sessions.

scripts.time_modes.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Time only the build stages that differ between C modes, with the production
# arguments and the staged prealloc compiler of this session's parallel build.
#   parallel: V generates and compiles the C with -parallel-cc + ThinLTO, then links
#   single:   V writes Vox.c (+flags) and exits; one clang call compiles and links it
#             (production --no-parallel-cc path, without freeze's preprocessing copy)
# usage: time_modes.sh parallel|single LABEL
set -eu
mode=$1
label=$2
L=/Users/alex/code/vox2/Build/pcc-ab-20261105
out=$L/times/$label
mkdir -p "$out"
repo=/Users/alex/code/vox2
skia_root="$repo/../3rd/ladybird/Build/release/vcpkg_installed/arm64-osx-dynamic"
ldflags="-Wl,-dead_strip,-dead_strip_dylibs -L$repo/Build/v/rust-yuv/release -lladybird_v_yuv -L$L/stage -lLadybirdVSkiaText -Wl,-rpath,@executable_path -Wl,-rpath,$skia_root/lib -lc++ $skia_root/lib/libicuuc.dylib -Wl,-rpath,$skia_root/lib"
cflags=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$L/v-args.json'))['cflags'])")
compiler=$(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$L/receipt/c-compile.json'))['compiler'])")
uptime > "$out/load-before.txt"
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$out/start.txt"
cd "$(dirname "$compiler")"
export V_MACOS_V3_NO_FALLBACK=1
if [ "$mode" = parallel ]; then
    V3_PARALLEL_CC_REQUIRE_SPLIT=1 /usr/bin/time -l -o "$out/time-v.txt" python3 -c "
import json, os, sys
a = json.load(open('$L/v-args.json'))['args']
os.execv('$compiler', ['$compiler', *a, *sys.argv[1:]])" \
        -show-timings -parallel-cc -cflags "$cflags -flto=thin" \
        -ldflags "$ldflags -flto=thin -Wl,-mllvm,-inline-threshold=1500" \
        -o "$out/Vox" "$repo" > "$out/v.log" 2>&1
else
    /usr/bin/time -l -o "$out/time-v.txt" python3 -c "
import json, os, sys
a = json.load(open('$L/v-args.json'))['args']
os.execv('$compiler', ['$compiler', *a, *sys.argv[1:]])" \
        -show-timings -cflags "$cflags" -ldflags "$ldflags" \
        -dump-c-flags "$out/Vox.flags" -o "$out/Vox.c" "$repo" > "$out/v.log" 2>&1
    /usr/bin/time -l -o "$out/time-cc.txt" python3 "$L/compile_single.py" \
        "$out/Vox.flags" "$out/Vox.c" "$out/Vox" > "$out/cc.log" 2>&1
fi
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$out/end.txt"
uptime > "$out/load-after.txt"
ls -la "$out/Vox" > "$out/executable.txt"
rm -f "$out/Vox.c" "$out/Vox"
echo "$label ($mode) done"
scripts.summarize_times.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Summarize time_modes.sh runs: C generation, C compile + link, total, CPU, peak RSS, load.
usage: summarize_times.py LABEL..."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'times'


def tl(path):
    t = path.read_text()
    real = float(re.search(r'([\d.]+) real', t).group(1))
    cpu = float(re.search(r'([\d.]+) user', t).group(1)) + float(re.search(r'([\d.]+) sys', t).group(1))
    rss = int(re.search(r'(\d+)\s+maximum resident', t).group(1)) / 1e9
    return real, cpu, rss


print('| run | mode | V wall | C generation | native objects | C compile + link wall | total wall | total CPU | peak RSS | load (1 min) before/after |')
print('|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|')
for label in sys.argv[1:]:
    d = root / label
    log = (d / 'v.log').read_text(errors='replace')
    stages = {m.group(1).strip(): float(m.group(2)) / 1000
              for m in re.finditer(r'^  ([a-zA-Z(). /]+?)\s+([\d.]+) ms', log, re.M)}
    v_real, v_cpu, v_rss = tl(d / 'time-v.txt')
    cache = stages.get('C object cache', 0.0)
    if (d / 'time-cc.txt').exists():
        mode = 'single'
        cc_real, cc_cpu, cc_rss = tl(d / 'time-cc.txt')
        generation = v_real - cache
        compile_wall = cc_real
        total, cpu, rss = v_real + cc_real, v_cpu + cc_cpu, max(v_rss, cc_rss)
    else:
        mode = 'parallel'
        compile_wall = stages.get('cc', 0.0)
        generation = stages.get('total', v_real) - compile_wall - cache
        total, cpu, rss = v_real, v_cpu, v_rss
    lb = (d / 'load-before.txt').read_text().split('averages:')[1].split()[0]
    la = (d / 'load-after.txt').read_text().split('averages:')[1].split()[0]
    print(f'| {label} | {mode} | {v_real:.0f} s | {generation:.0f} s | {cache:.0f} s | {compile_wall:.0f} s | '
          f'{total:.0f} s | {cpu:.0f} s | {rss:.1f} GB | {lb} / {la} |')
